[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''J. M. Harrin''' was in command of the [[Edan Spaceways]] [[trans-oceanic shuttle]], [[EAV Bothan Whale|EAV ''Bothan Whale'']]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], he was working the seas of his homeworld, [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]].
